name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain=animate>_<descriptor=screen_shake>; no Ghidra address residue; accurately reflects an animated screen-shake (vertical jitter) effect. Consistent with the fd2_animate_* family (e.g. fd2_animate_palette_flash_pulse_white, fd2_animate_warp_in_expand).
purpose: Plays an animated screen-shake (vertical 1-row jitter) of the battle scene for num_frames frames.
logic_summary: Snapshots the current battle scene once into the render workspace (large_game_state_buffer + 0x8088) via fd2_composite_battle_tile_map in mode 9 (0x1C8 stride, 0xD tiles, window origin x/y), then runs fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) as the finalizer. Then loops i = 0..num_frames-1: each iteration blits the visible 312x192 (0x138 x 0xC0) region to the mode13h primary at 0xA0504 (dst stride 0x140) from the workspace base on even iterations or one screen-row lower (+0x1C8 bytes) on odd iterations -- (i & 1) * 0x1C8 -- producing a perceived up/down jitter, then fd2_delay_ms(0x14) waits ~20ms before the next frame. CHK(0x24) stack-probe prologue. cdecl, void return.

params.name: num_frames
params.semantics: Number of jitter frames to play; loop counter for the blit/delay loop (signed compare i < num_frames).
params.reason: Accurately names the loop iteration count; no address residue. Callers (chapter 23/25/29 cinematics) pass a small frame count to control shake duration.

comment_original_issue: Src comment stated the per-frame delay as '20-tick (~1100ms)'. fd2_delay_ms is a millisecond-delay wrapper (delay(ms)), so fd2_delay_ms(0x14) waits ~20 milliseconds, not 20 ticks / ~1100ms. The Ghidra plate already had it correct ('20ms per frame').
notes: Verified fd2_delay_ms @ 0x375B2 is the ms-delay wrapper (delay(ms)) -> 0x14 == ~20ms; this fixes the only comment inaccuracy. Global symbol names in src match Ghidra byte-identical (data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr @ 0x53A49, data_fd2_battle_view_window_origin_x @ 0x53AA9, _y @ 0x53AAD). Decompile matches src body 1:1 (composite snapshot mode 9, finalizer frame, jitter blit loop, ms delay). Name + param kept; no logic changes made.
